item.title: Trump administration arrests Southern Poverty Law Center expert for fraud
item.description: Heidi Beirich, an expert on far-right extremism, has been charged over alleged misuse of donor funds to pay informants.

item.title: Media groups sue Trump over paid access to public social media posts
item.description: Lawsuit claims Trump profits unfairly by charging up to $100,000 monthly for exclusive access to presidential posts.

item.title: Trump administration plans to give ICE officers electric-shock gloves
item.description: US Homeland Security is expected to buy up to $20m in gloves amid criticism of the president's immigration crackdown.

item.title: US strikes in Yemen killed 153 civilians in 2025, says Pentagon review
item.description: The unclassified Pentagon review sheds new light on civilian harm from the US campaign against Yemen’s Houthis.

item.title: Hegseth cautions that ICC may investigate US boat strikes in Latin America
item.description: US defence chief vows to continue campaign against drug cartels, says Colombia has joined regional military coalition.

item.title: PSG win back-to-back UEFA Super Cups with victory over Aston Villa
item.description: Kvaratskhelia and Doue earn a win for Paris Saint-Germain as 17-year-old Brian Madjo's goal is in vain for Aston Villa.

item.title: Thousands missing after Colombia quake as rescue continues
item.description: Thousands missing after Colombia quake as rescue continues

item.title: Morocco says working to prevent potential new Ceuta crossings surge
item.description: Morocco Interior Ministry says it has increased security along its borders with the Spanish exclaves Ceuta and Melilla.

item.title: 11-year-old boy shot by Israeli forces in Gaza
item.description: The father of an 11-year-old boy says Israeli forces shot his son in the head and leg in Khan Younis.

item.title: Drone attacks on energy infrastructure deepen Libya’s energy crisis
item.description: Repeated drone strikes on oil and power infrastructure are deepening Libya's energy crisis.

item.title: Israeli air strike kills one in northern Gaza
item.description: Strike on a tuk-tuk in Beit Lahiya kills one, wounds five in first Israeli aerial bombardment in a week

item.title: Deadly India landslide kills at least seven in Mumbai
item.description: Heavy rains triggered a landslide on Wednesday that killed at least seven people in India’s western Maharashtra state.

item.title: Can Syria deliver transitional justice?
item.description: A court has sentenced ousted former leader Bashar al-Assad and others to death in absentia.

item.title: Israel vows to keep troops in Lebanon, Gaza and Syria
item.description: Israeli defence minister Israel Katz has said that Israel “will under no circumstances” withdraw its troops.

item.title: Photos: Solar eclipse plunges parts of Europe into darkness
item.description: A total solar eclipse crossed Iceland, Britain and parts of the European continent, drawing crowds to watch the event.

item.title: ‘Platformicide’ of Palestine: Activists struggle to be heard on Meta
item.description: Report by NGO 7amleh, Utrecht University analyses 3,520 cases of digital rights violations against Palestinians.

item.title: Trump reveals Karoline Leavitt to step down as White House press secretary
item.description: Leavitt is departing her role to spend more time with family after giving birth to a second child, according to Trump.

item.title: Josh Kushner, Bob Iger, buying Los Angeles Lakers for record $12.5bn
item.description: Billionaire Mark Walter's sale of the NBA's Lakers is a record-breaking valuation for a North American sports franchise.

item.title: Iceland and Spain plunged into darkness during total solar eclipse
item.description: A total solar eclipse took place in Iceland and Spain as crowds gathered to watch.

item.title: Brazil orders Discord to suspend livestreams after teen’s death
item.description: Regulator says Discord failed to protect minors from violence, self-harm, and suicide content.

item.title: Iraq says September 30 withdrawal deadline for US-led coalition ‘final’
item.description: A US official confirmed that the United States expects to complete its pullout by September 30.

item.title: Thousands flee drought in Somalia amid sharp aid decline
item.description: Thousands of hunger-stricken families have lost their livestock and farms due to a yearslong drought in Somalia.

item.title: Paramount Skydance mulls CNN sale amid antitrust merger challenge
item.description: Paramount’s legal officer hints at CNN sale as 12 states, led by California, file lawsuit to block merger with WBD.

item.title: DR Congo Ebola outbreak set to become deadliest on record, WHO warns
item.description: Outbreak to eclipse West Africa's Ebola outbreak of 2014 to 2016 if it continues at current pace, WHO chief says.

item.title: Lebanese families demand release of detainees held by Israel
item.description: Lebanese families rallied in Beirut demanding answers about relatives detained by Israel.
